resources.string: SubRead Overlay: position of the media player

Shows the lines of a subtitle file (.srt) over the app that plays the audiobook or the video: Voice, VLC, mpv, YouTube, a podcast app. The line follows the position of the player. Tap a word to select it, drag to select more, then send it to a dictionary.
This app has no network permission. Nothing leaves the device.
Android must allow the subtitle panel on top of the media player.
2. Read the position of the media player

Android gives the position of other apps only to an app with notification access. SubRead Overlay uses this access for the media position, the speed and play or pause. It does not read, keep or send a notification.
No app on this device takes a selected text. Install a dictionary that has an entry in the text selection menu.
How much of the player shows through the panel. The text stays black.
One line: the line that the narrator reads.
Three lines: the line before and the line after too, small and grey. The panel grows to fit them.
Android starts the listener. Try again in a moment.
Choose a subtitle file in SubRead Overlay.
The subtitle file has no lines that the app can read.
No media player. Start the audiobook or the video.
SubRead Anki did not take the card.
No .srt for your audiobook? The SubRead app makes it from the audiobook and its ebook, on this device.

One tap on "Anki" under a selected word makes a card in AnkiDroid: the word, its reading and definition, the line, a screenshot of the player and the audio. SubRead Anki does this, with SubRead Dictionary for the definition.
